Correctly Spelt Word: ausmachen
Word Type: separable verb

Definitions:
a. To constitute, make up, or account for.
b. To agree upon or arrange.
c. To bother or matter to someone (used with a dative object, typically in questions or negative statements).

Examples:

(Renewable energy now accounts for more than half of electricity generation.)
